summary: Data Analyst hero source image: an isolated full-body hero pose of the Data Analyst stakeholder on a clean white or very light background. The figure is a young adult woman with warm brown skin, large round glasses, and brown curly hair pulled into a loose high bun. She wears a cream oversized cardigan over a white top, high-waisted brown trousers, mustard socks, and light cream sneakers, with a purple lanyard and badge. She holds a clipboard or tablet showing analytics graphics such as a filter funnel, check marks, and bar or donut charts, plus a small paper packet. The style matches the Issue #56 stakeholder pack: clean vector-adjacent painterly rendering, simplified readable props, and a warm, organized, helpful mood. Intended as the canonical hero source for the Data Analyst, pending pixel-level review.
